crossRefs.note: In seven days, I will cause it to rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights. I will destroy every living thing…
It rained on the earth forty days and forty nights.

translations.web: The flood was forty days on the earth. The waters increased, and lifted up the ship, and it was lifted up above the earth.
translations.bsb: For forty days the flood kept coming on the earth, and the waters rose and lifted the ark high above the earth.
translations.kjv: And the flood was forty days upon the earth; and the waters increased, and bare up the ark, and it was lift up above the earth.
translations.asv: And the flood was forty days upon the earth; and the waters increased, and bare up the ark, and it was lifted up above the earth.
